compatibility.instructions: Does this grain preserve all contracts: three new static pages plus home footer links plus one source-test module; no route/schema/API/MCP/migration/dependency/config change; web CI glob auto-wires the suite; existing pages/routes untouched? Any changed behavior?

correctness.instructions: Are the pages factually correct: privacy states local-first storage, masking, and no third-party AI egress on qualified paths; terms invents no license and defers commercial terms to the owner; support states self-hosted boundaries with runbook/tracker pointers? Any invented claim?

evidence.instructions: Is evidence sufficient: 3 source tests pass (posture markers, static/no-fetch/no-secret, cross-links); lint/typecheck clean; production build prerenders all three at 174 B with shared 103 kB intact? Any test claim without a run?

reliability.instructions: Any reliability risk: server-rendered static pages with no client JS, no data fetching, no failure mode beyond the app shell?

scope.instructions: Anything beyond the legal surfaces: hosted legal CMS, consent management, cookie banners, or unrelated refactors? Are formal commercial terms honestly still owner work?

security.instructions: Does the grain weaken any control: no fetch/env/secrets in pages; no user input; cross-links are static routes? Any leakage?
